Scan Network:

Bonjour uses industry standard IP protocols to allow devices to automatically discover each other without the need to enter IP addresses or configure DNS servers. The Bonjour-Browser in iNet scans the connected local network for Bonjour services, detecting any hardware that ist connected via the Bonjour protocol (for instance computer, router, printer, …) and any software running Bonjour services, e. g. iTunes or Filemaker.

Readable Voice is a Mac, iPhone and iPad app that scans your audio files and converts recognizable speech into text.


Readable Voice makes audio accessible. The app allows you to create text from audio or video, also known as transcription. Simply add your file and watch how the text is being created. Afterwards you can correct text errors directly in the app. Unlike other apps, everything is being processed right on your device. No internet connection is required. If you don't understand the language of the audio, the app can translate it for you as well. Machine learning is being used to recognize words and sentences of almost 100 languages and dialects.

Universal Purchase - Buy once on the App Store and enjoy the app on all platforms (Mac, iPhone, iPad) without the need for separate purchases or additional costs.

Key Features:
• Specifically designed and engineered to work optimally with macOS, iOS and iPadOS
• Drag and drop your file into the application window or on the app icon
• Batch transcribe multiple files or contents of folders
• Start an audio recording directly in the app and then transcribe it
• The transcribed speech can be translated into your desired language
• Files with almsot 100 languages and dialects can be transcribed
• Wide support of audio and video file formats including MP3, AAC, MOV, MP4, AIFF, WAV and many more
• Everything is being processed entirely on your device, no Internet connection is required
